requested_artifact_type: safe non-runtime work-order bundle and evidence map; no scoring; no readiness claim
objective: Convert the host-by-host evidence-scope index into exact bounded future proof-or-defer work orders for Claude, Cursor and Codex plus cross-host token/quality/learnability/lifecycle/docs gaps, without launching runtime or running scoring/training.
must_load_before_writing: safe existing host/runtime/docs summary artifacts only; raw-private request/response/trace contents remain forbidden
required_outputs: one exact future proof-or-defer work order draft for Claude
one exact future proof-or-defer work order draft for Cursor
one exact future proof-or-defer work order draft for Codex
forbidden: proof runner, proof producer, quality scorer or eval runner execution
token savings, quality improvement, runner-ready, quality-pass, product readiness or final readiness claims
admission_gate: The bundle may prepare future work orders only. It must not claim any host or cross-host requirement complete unless exact existing evidence already proves that row, and this work order is not allowed to create such runtime/scoring/training evidence.

required_pre_return_state_consistency_ve.reason: This state current_phase/next_action defect repeated and must be checked before future packets return.
must_verify: next_action matches the selected follow-up work order
next_bounded_product_phase matches the selected follow-up work order when present
checks-report records the state consistency verification result
